summary: A Yes vote amends the Davis General Plan and land use designations to authorize the Willowgrove residential development, including housing, retail, parks, trails, and open space.

housing.text: A Yes vote approves the Willowgrove development, allowing more than 1,200 new housing units to move forward.
housing.quote: The project, which Davis voters will vote on during the November general election as Measure W, proposes putting more than 1,200 new units on a 234-acre plot of land just down the street from the former Village Farms site.

housing.text: A No vote rejects the Willowgrove development and does not allow those new housing units to move forward.
housing.quote: The project, which Davis voters will vote on during the November general election as Measure W, proposes putting more than 1,200 new units on a 234-acre plot of land just down the street from the former Village Farms site.
